description: Unit tests for the Daemon class in the OpenMRS API, testing thread management, user creation, and task execution.

classes.name: PrivateSchedulerTask
classes.description: A TimerSchedulerTask wrapper for testing execution of tasks within the Daemon context.

classes.name: PrivateTask
classes.description: A simple task that marks itself as run when executed.

classes.name: TaskThatStartsAnotherThread
classes.description: A task that spawns a new daemon thread and marks itself as run.

classes.name: TaskThatStartsAnotherFuture
classes.description: A task that spawns a new daemon thread returning a Future<Boolean> to indicate completion.

classes.name: TestTask
classes.description: A test task that verifies the daemon user has an associated person.

methods.name: executeScheduledTask_shouldNotBeCalledFromOtherMethodsOtherThanTimerSchedulerTask
methods.description: Ensures that Daemon.executeScheduledTask throws an exception when called from non-allowed classes.

methods.name: executeScheduledTask_shouldNotThrowErrorIfCalledFromATimerSchedulerTaskClass
methods.description: Verifies that a task implementing TimerSchedulerTask can be executed without errors.

methods.name: createUser_shouldThrowWhenCalledOutsideContextDAO
methods.description: Test that createUser throws an exception when invoked outside the proper DAO context.

methods.name: createUser_shouldCreateUserWithRolesInContextDAO
methods.description: Tests creating a user with roles within the DAO context.

methods.name: createUser_shouldThrowWhenUserExists
methods.description: Ensures that creating a duplicate user throws an exception.

methods.name: runInNewDaemonThread_shouldThrowErrorIfCalledFromANonDaemonThread
methods.description: Verifies that attempting to spawn a daemon thread from a non-daemon thread throws an exception.

methods.name: runInNewDaemonThreadCallable_shouldThrowErrorIfCalledFromANonDaemonThread
methods.description: Same as above, for the callable variant.

methods.name: runNewDaemonTask_shouldThrowErrorIfCalledFromANonDaemonThread
methods.description: Ensures that spawning a daemon task from a non-daemon thread is forbidden.

methods.name: runInNewDaemonThread_shouldNotThrowErrorIfCalledFromADaemonThread
methods.description: Confirms that daemon threads can spawn other daemon threads.

methods.name: runInNewDaemonThreadCallable_shouldNotThrowErrorIfCalledFromADaemonThread
methods.description: Same as above, for the callable variant.

methods.name: daemonUser_shouldHaveAssociatedPerson
methods.description: Tests that the daemon user always has an associated Person object.

methods.name: isDaemonUser_shouldReturnTrueForADaemonUser
methods.description: Checks that a user with the daemon UUID is recognized as daemon user.

methods.name: isDaemonUser_shouldReturnFalseIFTheUserIsNotADaemon
methods.description: Checks that a user without the daemon UUID is not recognized as daemon user.
